dimensions.evidence: Expression is dimensionally sound: c[count] x (A/A0 [length^2/length^2 = dimensionless])^z[dimensionless] = count. A/A0 length^2, z dimensionless, S count all consistent. BUT variable c declares dimensions 'count / length^(2z)' -- the unnormalized-form dimension -- contradicting the r2 expression (c must be a count: richness at A=A0), its own unit 'count', definition 'richness at unit area', and translation notes ('c (richness at unit area) times the dimensionless ratio^z gives a species count'). Stale r1 leftover; required correction: set c dimensions to 'count'.
